english.title: Driver of goods vehicle on journey between member states fail to comply with direction of stopping officer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE TYPE AND INDEX MARK..), wilfully failed to comply with a direction given by a stopping officer to stop the vehicle for the purpose of enabling an examiner to exercise the power to inspect it under regulation 25(2)(a) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(2) and 27(2) and (7) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024.
